definition: Tools an agent can use through an agent-ready outside service (an MCP server or a self-serve API) with a subscription and no integration work. Counted in semantius_agent_first, not in semantius_agent_core.

status_legend.official: MCP server or agent toolkit published by the vendor
status_legend.official_beta: vendor-published, in beta or early access
status_legend.community: open-source or third-party server over the vendor's public API
status_legend.aggregator: multi-app MCP gateway (Zapier, viaSocket) exposing the vendor's actions

caveat: Researched from vendor docs, directories and reviews on 2026-10-23; directory listings disagree in places. Verify endpoints and scopes in each vendor's own documentation before relying on them.
